description: Change a recurring block FROM A DATE ONWARD (title, duration, fixed time, weekdays). The past is never rewritten: earlier days keep their blocks as they were, and the habit keeps its history. Upcoming occurrences already created and not yet checked are updated, or removed if their day is no longer planned. To change a single day only, use update_day_block on that day's block instead.

anchor_time.description: Fixed wall-clock hour HH:MM. Pass null to let the block follow the wake time.

from_date.description: First day the change applies (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today (UTC).

id.description: Recurring block UUID (from list_recurring_blocks, or `repeats.recurring_block_id` of a day block)

weekdays.description: ISO weekdays the block comes back on: 1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday. Every day = [1,2,3,4,5,6,7]; working week = [1,2,3,4,5].

name: update_recurring_block
